caption: Figure 6. Overall learning pipeline of the proposed LDL method.
remaining_limitations: Agreement is assessed against the supplied original figure and associated text, not independent validation of the scientific method.

role_and_message.evidence: The revised image remains the overall LDL training framework: one low-resolution input feeds the online and EMA models; outputs construct the artifact map and training loss.

panel_and_object_coverage.evidence: Both Ψ and Ψ_EMA, I_LR, I_SR1, I_SR2, I_HR, M_refine, L_artif, the GAN contribution and the training return are visibly present.

labels_math_and_numbers.evidence: All original symbolic names and subscripts remain recognizable. Added “Refined artifact map” and “Artifact loss” agree with Section 3.3 and Eq. (7); no new numerical claim appears.

connections_and_direction.evidence: I_SR1, I_SR2 and I_HR each enter M_refine; I_SR1, M_refine and I_HR each enter L_artif once. The loss plus L_GAN returns to Ψ, and dashed parameter averaging goes from Ψ to Ψ_EMA.

visual_encodings.evidence: Gray solid paths represent data flow/training, dashed gray denotes EMA, orange denotes map-construction inputs and green denotes loss inputs; the legend matches these displayed paths.

examples_and_data.evidence: The source contains a symbolic model diagram without photographs, measurements or performance outcomes; the revision adds no example, numerical result or substituted data.

unsupported_additions.evidence: Added semantic labels name operations already supported by the source image and the inspected text; no new model, loss term or scientific relation is introduced.

complete_visible_content.evidence: The final PNG contains the complete two-model pathway, the upper feedback lane, both right-side boxes, all labels and the four-entry legend with visible margins and no clipped text.

repair_verification: The extra vertical I_HR-to-L_artif arrow is removed. The retained rightmost I_HR path enters L_artif once; its separate orange path still enters M_refine. The gray legend now reads “Data flow / training”.
